# GEMFORGE published-build verification (cloud, 2026-11-14)

**Scope:** published build artifacts in `error404aaron/gemforge-app` only. Source repository
`error404aaron/gemforge` was not accessible to this session (attach request denied), so typecheck,
unit tests, production build and source changes were **not** performed here.

**Do not merge this folder into `main`.** `main` is the GitHub Pages site and is generated by the
source repository's publish script; this folder is a verification record on a development branch.

## Recovered repository state

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `main` HEAD | `aab863c` — Publish GEMFORGE 0.7.2 (source `4ca6deb`) |
| Previous publishes | `10e7e14` 0.7.1 (source `810e99d`), `0b0f220` 0.7.0 (source `14eb259`), `66fef0a` 0.6.0 (source `c9e7f47`) |
| `version.json` on `main` | `{"version":"0.7.2","source":"4ca6deb"}` |
| In-app version label | `v0.7.2 · 4ca6deb` |
| Live site | Not reachable from this sandbox (proxy 403); production state inferred from `main` only |

The brief's baseline ("production v0.7.0, target v0.7.1") is out of date: by repository evidence
0.7.1 and 0.7.2 were both published to `main` on 2026-11-14.

## Method

Each published build was extracted from git history (`git archive <commit>`) and served by
`tests/server.js` at `http://localhost:8765/gemforge-app/` (mirrors the Pages sub-path,
`Cache-Control: max-age=600` like Pages). The served version can be switched live to simulate a
deploy. Tests are plain Playwright scripts driving the real UI (taps/clicks on `data-testid`s).

Environment: Linux cloud container, Node 22.23.4, Playwright 1.63.0, Chromium 1243 (headless),
15 GiB RAM, 1 worker, sequential tests.

## Results (commit under test: `aab863c`, build 0.7.2 unless stated)

### Daily Forge — 9/9 PASS (`results/results-daily-forge.json`)
D1 start (date, seed = FNV-1a(`gemforge-daily:`+date), depth 0) · D2 determinism across contexts,
other date differs · D3 local-date per timezone · D4 mid-battle save/resume · D5 midnight rollover ·
D6 defeat recorded, normal record untouched · D7 victory recorded (fixture: final battle, foe 1 hp),
normal record untouched · D8 restart retries same daily, New run returns to normal · D9 tampered
daily save rejected (fail-closed).

### PWA — 7/7 PASS (`results/results-pwa.json`)
P1 fresh install, single cache `gemforge-v7-c445cc95eb4b` with all 8 files · P2 offline cold start:
boot, resume save, play, version label, start daily · P3 offline navigation fallback ·
P4 0.6.0→0.7.2 (save v5→v6 migration) · P5 0.7.0→0.7.2 · P6 0.7.1→0.7.2 · P7 0.7.0→0.7.1.
Every upgrade: old caches deleted, save and record preserved, correct version shown, offline start
serves the new build.

Upgrade behaviour observed:
- From 0.7.1+: new UI live ~2.8 s after the first post-deploy launch, by automatic reload.
- From 0.6.0/0.7.0: those clients have no `controllerchange` reload hook (added in 0.7.1), so the
  **first** post-deploy launch still shows the old UI; the new service worker takes over in ~3 s and the
  **next** launch is the new version. Cannot be changed retroactively; expected, not a 0.7.2 defect.

### Mobile / desktop — 9/10 (`results/results-ui-mobile-desktop.json`)
PASS: iPhone 13, iPhone SE, iPhone 14 Pro Max portrait (full-screen, no overflow, all controls in
viewport, buttons ≥ 40 px, guide fits) · complete run by tap only with reward/end overlays fitting ·
touch drag card→slot · `viewport-fit=cover` + `env(safe-area-inset-*)` on `.game` and `.guide` ·
desktop 1280×800 full run, new run, sound preference persists, version label · mouse drag · Escape
closes guide. No console errors in any test.

**FAIL (cosmetic, low severity):** iPhone 13 landscape (750×342): the three hand cards extend 4 px
below the viewport (bottom 346–348 vs 342); iPhone 14 Pro Max landscape by 3 px. Cards remain
tappable; the manifest requests portrait, but Safari tabs can rotate. Evidence:
`results/ui-iPhone_13_landscape-battle.png`. Fix belongs in the source repo (`--cw` card-size clamp
for short landscape viewports).

## Not verified (limitations)
- Typecheck, unit tests, production build: source repo not accessible.
- **WebKit / iPhone Safari:** WebKit browser not installed in this environment; all "iPhone" results
  are Chromium with iPhone device emulation, not Safari. Real safe-area inset values, iOS standalone
  mode and Safari service-worker behaviour remain unverified.
- Live production URL: not reachable from the sandbox.
- Service-worker update on `visibilitychange` (≥ 60 s) path: not exercised.

## Harness corrections made during the run (recorded for audit)
- `waitForFunction` with an async predicate resolved immediately (Promise is truthy); replaced with a
  Node-side poll. The earlier P4/P5/P7 failures were caused by this, not by the app.
- Playwright `dragTo` sends a single move event, so the app did not treat it as a drag; replaced
  with a stepped mouse drag (12 moves), which matches real input.
- A vacuous `|| true` assertion in D7 was removed before the final run.
